create.title: Unbalanced product regrouping and fixed-centre truncated-divisor return
create.statement_tex: For every strict smooth unbalanced M2 component with K=XL/D^2, M=LK, F=sqrt(XM)=XL/D and flat normalized cutoffs, T_(L,K)=sum_(h,k)chi_4(h)a_(L,K)(h,k)e(sqrt(Xhk)) groups exactly as sum_n A_(L,K)(n)e(sqrt(Xn)), with A_(L,K)(n)=sum_(hk=n)chi_4(h)a_(L,K)(h,k), sum_n|A_(L,K)(n)|^2<<_epsilon MX^epsilon, and separated Dirichlet series L(s-it_1,chi_4)zeta(s-it_2). The literal truncated coefficient does not equal r_2(n)/4. The two degree-one root numbers are +1 and the formal dual factor scales are X/D and D. Resolving chi_4 and applying the smooth h-process gives h_*=4Xk/r^2 and combined coefficient 2sqrt(2)i e(-1/8)chi_4(r)(Xk)^(1/2)r^(-3/2); substitution of the literal symbol and the inherited physical normalization leaves exactly -i/(2pi) times the r,k row. Exact k-Poisson returns the prescribed-centre truncated-divisor wavelet sum_s sum_(r|s,r odd) chi_4(r)W(X/(rD)) int q_L(h)h^(-1)e(hr(X-s)/(4X))dh, rapidly supported on |s-X|<<D/L. On a fixed flat smooth component the aggregate h-process error is O(KF^(-1/2)), hence O(L^(-1)) after physical normalization; sharp clipped, starred, hard or arithmetic-owner boundaries require their exact endpoint kernels. Absolute divisor bounds give (D/L)X^epsilon, so the missing power is D/(LX^(1/4))=H_D/L and vanishes only on the prior terminal line. A sliding-window outside-absolute correlation bound for the exact A_(L,K) is sufficient for the three-quarter target but remains unproved.
create.next_action: Attack the literal signed fixed-centre wavelet before absolute values, or the exact outside-absolute shifted product correlation. Do not repeat r_2 completion, functional-equation inversion, scalar Plancherel, or coefficient-blind cone arguments. Preserve endpoint kernels outside the flat smooth scope.
create.reason_for_promotion: Exact product algebra, Mellin modes, character transfer, Gaussian constant, symbol cancellation, dual lengths, k-Poisson kernel, raw capacity, signed-correlation implication and the flat-smooth aggregate error were independently reproduced and hostilely scoped. The statement explicitly leaves the signed estimate and all sharp endpoint owners open.

update.next_action: Prove the actual prescribed-centre truncated-divisor wavelet R_(D,L)(X)<<_epsilon X^(1/4+epsilon), equivalently save H_D/L in the exact outside-absolute shifted product correlation. The transform and r_2 completion routes now have proved equal-capacity obstructions.

For the unbalanced smooth packet, the sign-preserving h-process and k-Poisson route returns exactly to a width-D/L fixed-centre truncated-divisor wavelet and saves no power. Any continuation must prove cancellation in that literal wavelet; another scalar transform is closed as a route.

The unbalanced child is now reduced to an exact fixed-centre signed truncated-divisor estimate but remains open. Close it together with the balanced quarter packet and hard signed cone before invoking this assembly.

reject.reason: The literal slanted packet contains only selected weighted divisor incidences. Prime, square and fourth-power controls show complementary divisors belong to other physical owners.
Popov requires complete r_2. At cutoff M his remainder is (D/L)X^o(1), which is target-safe only on the terminal line; at cutoff X^(1/2) the radial sum is equivalent to the Gauss target.
The reflected factor scales are X/D and D, their product is X, both root numbers are +1, and transform inversion preserves coefficient information and capacity.
The exact scale and Gaussian factors cancel to -i/(2pi), while k-Poisson returns a width-D/L fixed-centre wavelet. Its absolute deficit is exactly H_D/L.
The exact-product energy is O(MX^epsilon), but global Cauchy gives only the trivial M scale. Signed nonzero product shifts remain open.
The grouped coefficient is an irregular moving truncated divisor coefficient. Audited cone and one-variable exponent-pair theorems do not accept it and coefficient-blind analogues are false.

round_assessment.reason: Round 107 converts the vague unbalanced product-phase target into an exact prescribed-centre truncated-divisor wavelet, verifies its character and normalization through -i/(2pi), proves the flat-smooth aggregate error and signed-correlation implication, and decisively rejects automatic r_2 completion and transform-shortening shortcuts. It proves no new corridor, but isolates the exact missing factor and smallest coefficient-preserving survivor.
